shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a blue shirt sits in the plant-side window seat telling a puzzling story, while a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the counter-side window seat, a man in a purple shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat, and a man in a red shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt asks a clarifying question, and the man in a blue shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt continues telling the story.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the plant-side window seat.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt raises an objection, the man in a purple shirt dismisses the objection, and the man in a blue shirt explains the next detail.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the rectangular table.
